name: browser-use
headline: Vibe-Coding-Prompt-Template - AI-Powered MVP
short_description: Vibe-coding-prompt-template automates MVP development, PRDs, and technical designs using LLMs. Operations teams benefit from faster documentation and prototyping. Connects to AI IDEs and workflow automation tools.
author: KhazP

sections.overview:
Vibe-coding-prompt-template is a prompt template system designed to accelerate software development workflows using large language models. It automates the creation of minimum viable products (MVPs), product requirements documents (PRDs), and technical design specifications. The template integrates with AI IDEs like Claude Code and Cursor, as well as workflow automation platforms, enabling teams to generate structured documentation and prototypes faster. Operations and product teams benefit from reduced documentation overhead while maintaining consistency in design and specification outputs. The skill provides a reusable framework that standardizes how LLMs approach common development tasks.
Quickly generate a comprehensive PRD by answering guided questions.
Conduct market research and technical feasibility analysis in under 30 minutes.
Transform app ideas into working code through a structured 5-step workflow.
Create technical design documents that outline how to build your application.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/KhazP/vibe-coding-prompt-template`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a vibe-coded MVP specification for [PROJECT_NAME]. Include: 1) Core features in bullet points, 2) Tech stack recommendations with pros/cons, 3) API endpoints for [KEY_FUNCTIONALITY], 4) Database schema for [DATA_MODEL], 5) Frontend components needed. Use modern frameworks like Next.js, Supabase, and TailwindCSS. Keep it under 1000 words.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
